breakdown.description: The prompt switches from the exact thick-walled torsion relation given in the setup to a thin-walled tube approximation, which is a different model.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the error by instructing to 'Model the hollow circular shaft as a thin-walled closed tube,' introducing a mean radius rm = 23 mm, and directing use of 'the mean-area shear-flow relation for thin-walled tubes' and 'thin-walled tube theory.' The ground truth requires using the exact thick-walled torsion formulas (τ = T·c/J and φ = TL/GJ) with J = π(do^4 − di^4)/32, not a thin-walled approximation. The agent failed to correct this inconsistency and instead reinforced the incorrect model.
